AttemptIdentityV1 (frozen contract) minted per attempt with expected canonical base hash + generation.
Author/regen produce a complete ChapterV21 CANDIDATE in an isolated workspace; the conductor imports, validates, and commits. Agents never save repository files.
Typed-patch repair is IMP-07's package (contract frozen). Interim: repair edits a SEEDED workspace copy; conductor splices in memory and CAS-commits — canonical exposure already eliminated.
Attempt-scoped workspace outside canonical state; only the candidate path is expected; unexpected writes are first-class failures; codex sandbox confines writes to the workspace cwd.
Card instructions to save repository files / run gate CLIs removed; parse/schema/identity/gate/rubric/contract validation is conductor-owned.
Self-verify remains an in-card checklist only; it cannot execute commands from the workspace.
Malformed/oversized/missing/wrong-identity candidates classified distinctly (malformed_output / validation_failed) with evidence retained.
JSON, identity, size, and full gate-composite validation before any commit.
.attempts/ lives outside state/ — invisible to chapter enumeration, review, packaging, promotion by construction.
Gate composite runs in-process on the candidate with COMMITTED siblings as context; rubric substitutes the candidate into the committed book; contract reads the candidate object.
CAS on canonical hash; mismatch = stale_base, never rebase/overwrite/auto-retry (race test: exactly one of two same-base attempts commits).
Atomic tmp+rename replacement via writeFileAtomic as the canonical io default (fixes the F-001 torn-read wedge at the primitive too).
Pending/committed/aborted commit-manifest bracket; deterministic recovery for both crash points.
Workspace diff detects unexpected writes; the attempt fails; repository files are unreachable (cwd isolation).
Recovery is idempotent and runs on every mint for the chapter.
Bound to frozen Phase-0 contracts; the contracts-freeze test guards the versions.
All retry/repair/regeneration/acceptance caps unchanged — pinned by the existing suite (2,098 green).
